errors.evidence: The peak for the TSE (purple) line occurs in 2003 at approximately 990 Euro. In 2005, the value has already dropped significantly to about 750 Euro.

errors.text_span: und bleibt bis 2017 auf einem Niveau zwischen 100 und 150 Euro
errors.evidence: This describes the TSEC (green) line. While the value is in this range for some of the period after 2009, it dips to approximately 50 Euro in 2011, which is outside the stated range.
This describes the TSEB (blue) line. Between 1993 and 1997, the line does not remain stable but shows a clear increase from approximately 320 Euro to 450 Euro.

errors.text_span: steigt dann bis 2005 auf etwa 500 Euro
errors.evidence: This describes the TSEB (blue) line. The line peaks in 2003 at approximately 570 Euro, not in 2005. By 2005, the value had already decreased to about 480 Euro.

errors.text_span: fällt leicht bis 2007 auf etwa 400 Euro
errors.evidence: This describes the TSEB (blue) line. In 2007, the value is approximately 470 Euro, not 400 Euro.
